name: infillpk-theme
description: Asset build for the INFiLLPK WordPress theme.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: esbuild assets/js/hero.js assets/js/main.js assets/js/search.js assets/js/find-your-printer.js assets/js/pakistan-map.js --bundle --minify --outdir=assets/js --entry-names=[name].bundle --format=iife
scripts.watch:js: esbuild assets/js/hero.js assets/js/main.js assets/js/search.js assets/js/find-your-printer.js assets/js/pakistan-map.js --bundle --outdir=assets/js --entry-names=[name].bundle --format=iife --watch
